newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to seek 113-16 prop before bounce.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to seek 113-16 prop before bounce.

text.p: September T-bond futures look firm on Tuesday, provided nearby supports hold, technical analysts said.
"Above 113-16 it's still positive and we'd be looking for a break above the 114-15 high of Friday," said Raynard Cheng, technical analyst at First Chicago in London.
The 113-16 level was the low on daily charts on July 10. The July 8 low of 113-12 offered additional support, Cheng said.
September T-bonds were at 113-22 in automated trade at 1000 GMT, 8/32 below the Chicago settlement price.
Mike Macdonald, technical analyst at 4CAST in London, found major support at 113-03, the low of July 7.
"Trading from July 3 has been in a rising channel, but current prices are testing the bottom of that channel line. The 113-03 support would confirm a top at 114-15."
Macdonald also saw intermediate support at 113-16.
On the upside, the overnight high of 113-29 provides the first barrier, analysts said.
"There is intra-day congestion at 114-04, and then resistance at yesterday's high of 114-07," said Macdonald.
Beyond key 114-15, psychological 115-00 looms as resistance, Cheng said.
After that, the December 2 low on continuation charts of 115-22 comes into play.
December Eurodollars were 0.010 lower in automated trade, at 94.030.
